about:
Billy Warren & Son is a family-owned-and-operated business founded in 1978 in Greenwood, Delaware. The company has served customers in the region for over four decades, building a reputation as a local hardware supplier and metal service provider.

The firm operates as a hardware supplier and provides roll-off container service for scrap metal. Its product range includes industrial hardware, new metal, and surplus metal, with inventory that changes regularly. The company does not disclose facility size, headcount, or production volumes.

The business primarily serves construction projects and industrial customers seeking hardware and metal products. The website notes that customers turn to the supplier for construction projects, and the company positions itself as a go-to source for industrial hardware in the Greenwood area.

The company emphasizes its family heritage and the experience of its staff, stating that friendly personnel draw on more than 35 years of industry experience to assist customers. The "Metal is in Our Family" motto reflects the personal commitment behind the operation.
